corinthians1.13.p1.b1.text: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love …

corinthians1.13.p1.b2.text: … I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.

corinthians1.13.p1.b3.text: … but have not love, I am nothing.

corinthians1.13.p1.b4.text: … but have not love, I gain nothing.

corinthians1.13.p2.b5.text: Love is patient, love is kind. …

corinthians1.13.p2.b6.text: … it does not boast, it is not proud. It is not rude, it is not self-seeking …

corinthians1.13.p3.b7.text: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.

corinthians1.13.p3.b8.text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

corinthians1.13.p4.b10.text: … where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.

corinthians1.13.p4.b11.text: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. …

corinthians1.13.p4.b12.text: … When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.

corinthians1.13.p5.b13.text: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. …

corinthians1.13.p5.b14.text: … Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

corinthians1.13.p5.b15.text: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
